title: Nyevero diki pamberi pemunhu ari kufamba
intro: Pinda mumupata une mutongi ane simba neboka guru revanhu vari kuuya, wofungidzira mufambi mudiki achipa yambiro inoponesa nharaunda yese. Nharaunda iri panjodzi painosvika pakuvanda, njodzi yacho inopfuura. Tevedzera zviratidzo kuti uone munhu ari shure kweyambiro iyoyo.
clues: Ndiri pakati pezvisikwa zvidiki zvine chekuita neumambo hwemutongi.
Nzanga yangu inogara mudzimba dziri mumupata, uko mumwe wedu anogona kudana vamwe.
Tinotarisana nekutyisidzirwa nemutongi iyeye nemauto ari kufamba nemutongi.
Ndini ndinoshevedza nharaunda yangu kuti ipinde mudzimba dzavo uye ndinotinyevera kuti tisapwanyike tisingazive.
Mutongi ndiSulayman, uye rudzi rwangu ruri pakati pezvisikwa zvakaiswa pasi pake.
Ndiri svosve remupata iwoyo; mushure mekunyevera kwangu, takapinda mudzimba dzedu tikapukunyuka kupwanywa kwaizotibata tisingazive.

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro
options: Nharaunda yakaponeswa nekuti mauto akadzokera shure

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verse: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt. (29:48)
